title: Concrete Pump Spare Parts: Pistons, Valves, Pipes and Wear Parts
seoTitle: Concrete Pump Spare Parts Pistons Valves Pipes | Pinjin
description: Xingtai replacement wear parts for trailer pumps: split and integral pistons, S-tube and mixing seals, cylinder seals, pipes, elbows, clamps and hoses. Confirm OD or DN on the machine. Quote only — no list price, no small-batch parcels, not OEM parts of other brands.

answerBlock.what: Pinjin spare parts are Xingtai replacement wear parts for S-valve trailer pumps: split pistons φ150–φ280, integral pistons φ150–φ250, S-tube and mixing seals, main and swing cylinder seals, rubber springs, swing-arm balls, plus delivery pipe, DN200 90° elbow, DN80 clamp and delivery hose. Confirm outer diameter or DN on the pump. They are not OEM parts of other pump brands. Quote only; no published list price; not sold in small batches.
answerBlock.who: Owners of Pinjin trailers — and buyers replacing S-valve wear items by measured OD — who can send part name, size and quantity.
factors: Measure OD or DN on the machine before ordering
Piston type: split set versus integral piece, material as listed
Pipeline: DN on the pump page, not a guessed size
Commercial terms: project quantities, factory quote, no list price

faqs.question: Do these parts fit other concrete-pump brands as OEM?
faqs.answer: No. They are Xingtai replacement wear parts. Confirm the outer diameter or DN on your pump. We do not claim OEM interchange with other brands.

faqs.question: Is there a published price list or small-parcel shop?
faqs.answer: No. Send name, size and quantity for a factory quote. Small-batch shipping is not offered.
